dismiss-label.description:
Accessible name for the dismiss button. Override for localization; the
default English string is the component's only built-in user-visible text.

When to use: provide a localized action name whenever the document language
is not English.
When NOT to use: do not put the alert message here; use the default slot.

dismissed.description:
Reflected dismissed state. User dismissal sets it; applications may also
set or clear it. While true, the host remains in the document but renders no
alert subtree and leaves the accessibility tree. Clearing it re-shows the
alert and creates a dynamic live-region appearance.

When to use: persist or restore acknowledgement state from application
data.
When NOT to use: do not listen for programmatic changes as dismissal
events; `ki-dismiss` is only for user activation.

dismissible.description:
Renders one native dismiss button when true. The button sits outside the
live-region boundary, so its accessible name is not announced as part of
the alert message. When false, the alert adds no tab stop.

When to use: allow a person to acknowledge and clear a persistent message.
When NOT to use: do not use dismissible for auto-expiring messages; those
belong to `ki-toast`.

heading.description:
Optional emphasized text rendered before the message inside the live
region. Empty strings render no heading. The heading is a `strong`
element, not a document heading, so it never changes page outline.

When to use: add a short label when it helps identify the status message.
When NOT to use: do not use heading for page structure; use a real heading
outside the alert when the document needs one.

tone.description:
Semantic intent for visual styling and live-region urgency. `danger` and
`warning` expose `role="alert"`; `neutral`, `success`, `info`, absent, and
unrecognized values expose `role="status"`. Unknown values keep rendering
and fall back to the neutral token matrix by CSS construction.

When to use: choose the tone that describes the page or section state.
When NOT to use: do not use tone for layout, density, or filled-vs-outlined
styling; those are token/theme decisions.

--ki-alert-actions-gap.description: dimension used by the alert component for the gap between slotted actions (MarsUI Alert master CTAs gap Space/xl 12px).

--ki-alert-border-width.description: dimension used by the alert component for the card border width (the MarsUI Alert master card stroke is fully transparent). onmars v2 draws a hairline (spec 011 A2); material3 keeps its 2px border via its override.

--ki-alert-card-shadow.description: shadow used by the alert component for the card elevation (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap: elevation ramp level e5). An inline alert does not float, so onmars v2 and material3 lay the card flat.

--ki-alert-danger-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the danger card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone). onmars v2 tints the card with surface.danger-tint so the tone reads on the whole card (spec 011 A2); other themes may tint it per tone here too.

--ki-alert-danger-border.description: color used by the alert component for the danger card edge (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface). onmars v2 draws the outline.danger-low-em hairline around the tinted card (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-danger-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the danger card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

--ki-alert-danger-icon-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the danger icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/danger-base-em-alpha at 12%).

--ki-alert-danger-icon-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the danger icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/danger-high-em).

--ki-alert-dismiss-active-fg.description: color used by the alert component for dismiss active foreground.

--ki-alert-dismiss-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind the alert dismiss button.

--ki-alert-dismiss-border-width.description: dimension used by the alert component for the dismiss chip outline (MarsUI 24px circle: 1px Outline/secondary_button_top hairline).

--ki-alert-dismiss-hover-bg.description: color used by the alert component for dismiss hover background (MarsUI hover mechanism: hover-overlay-inverse Black/3 wash).

--ki-alert-dismiss-hover-fg.description: color used by the alert component for dismiss hover foreground.

--ki-alert-dismiss-icon-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for dismiss icon size (Figma close glyph box 16px inside the 24px raised circle; repointed from 18px per the fidelity audit).

--ki-alert-dismiss-radius.description: dimension used by the alert component for the dismiss chip shape (MarsUI Radius/radius_round full circle).

--ki-alert-dismiss-rest-fg.description: color used by the alert component for dismiss rest foreground.

--ki-alert-dismiss-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for dismiss size.

--ki-alert-focus-ring-color.description: color used by the alert component for focus ring color.

--ki-alert-focus-ring-offset.description: dimension used by the alert component for focus ring offset.

--ki-alert-focus-ring-shadow.description: shadow used by the alert dismiss control for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).

--ki-alert-focus-ring-width.description: dimension used by the alert component for focus ring width.

--ki-alert-font-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for font size.

--ki-alert-gap.description: dimension used by the alert component for the card stack gap between icon, text and actions (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap gap Space/xl 12px).

--ki-alert-heading-font-family.description: Font family for the alert heading. Override it to give alerts their own heading typeface.

--ki-alert-heading-font-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for heading font size.

--ki-alert-heading-font-weight.description: font weight used by the alert component for heading font weight (MarsUI UI/Body 2/medium: weight 600 on the master heading).

--ki-alert-icon-glyph-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon glyph inside the frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph 20px).

--ki-alert-icon-radius.description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon frame radius (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon: a circle).

--ki-alert-icon-size.description: dimension used by the alert component for the icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon size xs: 32px).

--ki-alert-info-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the info card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone). onmars v2 tints the card with surface.info-tint so the tone reads on the whole card (spec 011 A2); other themes may tint it per tone here too.

--ki-alert-info-border.description: color used by the alert component for the info card edge (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface). onmars v2 draws the outline.info-low-em hairline around the tinted card (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-info-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the info card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

--ki-alert-info-icon-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the info icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/info-base-em-alpha at 12%).

--ki-alert-info-icon-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the info icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/info-high-em).

--ki-alert-line-height.description: dimension used by the alert component for line height.

--ki-alert-message-line-height.description: dimension used by the alert component for message line height (MarsUI description is 13/20 line_height/para; the heading keeps 15/24).

--ki-alert-neutral-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the neutral card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone). onmars v2 keeps that card for the neutral tone and edges it with a hairline (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-neutral-border.description: color used by the alert component for the neutral card edge. onmars v2 draws it as the outline.low-em hairline of any flat card (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-neutral-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the neutral card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

--ki-alert-neutral-icon-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the neutral icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/primary-base-em-alpha at 12%: the master variable itself, not the heavier primary-tint content fill, so the primary glyph clears 4.5:1 in dark). onmars v2 keeps the accent off it: the frame takes the neutral card surface.

--ki-alert-neutral-icon-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the neutral icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/primary-high-em). onmars v2 draws it in the neutral text.high-em ink.

--ki-alert-padding-block.description: dimension used by the alert component for the card padding block (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap card: 12px on all four sides).

--ki-alert-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the alert component for the card padding inline (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap card: 12px on all four sides).

--ki-alert-radius.description: dimension used by the alert component for the card radius (MarsUI Alert master List_wrap big_component/radius_xs 16px; the shell around it has its own radius).

--ki-alert-shell-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind the alert shell.

--ki-alert-shell-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the shell wash (MarsUI Alert master Inverse-white/alpha-2: the nearest step of the Kimen inverse-white ramp, Black/3 light and White/3 dark). onmars v2 and material3 paint no shell: it is transparent.

--ki-alert-shell-padding.description: dimension used by the alert component for the shell padding around the card (MarsUI Alert master: 12px on all four sides). onmars v2 and material3 set it to zero, so the alert paints as one flat card (spec 011 A2, S31).

--ki-alert-shell-radius.description: dimension used by the alert component for the shell radius (MarsUI Alert master big_component/radius_lg 28px). A flat theme gives the shell the card radius.

--ki-alert-success-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the success card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone). onmars v2 tints the card with surface.success-tint so the tone reads on the whole card (spec 011 A2); other themes may tint it per tone here too.

--ki-alert-success-border.description: color used by the alert component for the success card edge (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface). onmars v2 draws the outline.success-low-em hairline around the tinted card (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-success-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the success card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

--ki-alert-success-icon-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the success icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/success-base-em-alpha at 12%).

--ki-alert-success-icon-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the success icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/success-high-em).

--ki-alert-text-gap.description: dimension used by the alert component for the heading-to-message stack gap (MarsUI Text_wrap 4px, decoupled from the outer 12px card gap).

--ki-alert-warning-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the warning card background (MarsUI Alert master: the List_wrap card is Surface/special/light-s0-dark-s2 in every tone). onmars v2 tints the card with surface.warning-tint so the tone reads on the whole card (spec 011 A2); other themes may tint it per tone here too.

--ki-alert-warning-border.description: color used by the alert component for the warning card edge (MarsUI draws no tone border on any alert/note/toast surface). onmars v2 draws the outline.warning-low-em hairline around the tinted card (spec 011 A2).

--ki-alert-warning-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the warning card foreground: heading and message ink (MarsUI Alert master Text/high-em in every tone; the message keeps this 4.5:1 ink instead of the master Text/low-em, spec 011 A1-D8).

--ki-alert-warning-icon-bg.description: color used by the alert component for the warning icon frame (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon Surface/warning-base-em-alpha at 12%).

--ki-alert-warning-icon-fg.description: color used by the alert component for the warning icon glyph (MarsUI Alert master Feature-icon glyph Text/warning-high-em).

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-effect-component-secondary-default-.description: MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_default: drop 0/2/1.5/-0.5 plus inner White/3 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.

--ki-motion-distance-sm.description: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.

--ki-motion-duration-medium-1.description: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).

--ki-outline-secondary-button-top.description: semantic color for outline secondary button top.

--ki-surface-special-light-s0-dark-s2.description: semantic color for surface special light s0 dark s2.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A persistent inline status message with token-backed tone semantics.

ki-dismiss.description:
Fired once after the user dismisses the alert — emitted after the alert is
hidden and focus has been handed to the next control. `detail` is `null`
and the event is not cancelable (the alert is already gone when it runs).
When to use: record acknowledgement, or advance an application flow after a
user closes the alert.
When NOT to use: do not treat it as a veto point, and do not expect it for
programmatic `dismissed` changes — it fires only for user activation.

actions.description: Row around the `actions` slot, rendered only when it holds content.

alert.description: Outer shell around the card: padding, radius, wash and blur.

card.description:
Card holding the icon, text, actions and dismiss control: tone
background, border, radius, padding and elevation.

dismiss.description: Native dismiss button, rendered only when dismissible.

heading.description: Optional emphasized heading, rendered only when non-empty.

icon.description:
Round frame around the `icon` slot, rendered when it holds content
or the tone draws a default glyph.

message.description: Message body wrapper around the default slot.

slots.description: Message body. It lives inside the live-region boundary.

actions.description:
Optional responses to this message, in a row at the bottom
of the card, outside the live region. Slot `size="sm"` buttons. The alert
never activates them and an action does not dismiss the alert; the
application does, by setting `dismissed`. When NOT to use: a response the
person cannot skip belongs in `ki-dialog`.

icon.description:
Optional decorative glyph shown in a round frame at the top of
the card, in the tone's colors. Hidden from assistive technology: it never
carries meaning the heading and message lack. Without one, a non-neutral
alert draws its tone's default glyph. When to use: replace the default
glyph, or give a neutral alert one. When NOT to use: never as the only cue
for the message.
